local_bottleneck: ACNC requires an Australian registered office and at least one Australian-resident governing-body member; ABN needed first.
fee_usd: none for ACNC (~$340 if ASIC-incorporated CLBG)
deduction: deductible at donor marginal rate, no cap, for registered charities
foreign_donor_restriction: none notable on inbound donations; organisation itself must be established in Australia for charity status
corrections: confirm prior: free ACNC registration, A$514 ASIC CLBG, 1-4 weeks, easy

local_bottleneck: Incorporated societies must have a New Zealand-resident secretary; donee (deductible) status needs NZ-resident board majority.
fee_usd: ~$70 (NZ$88.89 + GST for society incorporation; charity registration free)
time_to_register: 1-2 weeks for incorporation, 2-6 weeks with donee status
deduction: donee organisations: 30% tax credit plus income tax deduction for donors
corrections: confirm prior; verified incorporation fee NZ$88.89 (Incorporated Societies Regulations 2023) and free online charity registration

local_bottleneck: Companies Act 2015: CLBG needs 3 directors, 2 ordinarily resident in Fiji - the main remote-founder hurdle.
deduction: deductible for gifts to approved charitable entities, capped at 10% of assessable income
foreign_donor_restriction: none notable on inbound donations; charitable CLBGs must meet Companies Act 2015 ongoing duties
corrections: confirm prior: 2-of-3 resident-director rule verified against Companies Act 2015 ss 465-466 guidance

local_bottleneck: Resident PNG officers/company secretary plus local registered office required; IPA registry slow and mostly in-person.
deduction: deductible for gifts to eligible charitable organisations, capped at 10% of assessable income
foreign_donor_restriction: foreign NGOs operating in PNG must register (Associations Incorporation Act 2023 adds 'overseas association' category)
corrections: confirm prior; note new Associations Incorporation Act 2023 replaces 1966 Act, regulations commence 1 July 2026

local_bottleneck: At least one Samoa-resident director and a local registered office/agent required; payment at MCIL office.
deduction: deductible for gifts to eligible charitable institutions under Samoa Income Tax Act
foreign_donor_restriction: none notable on inbound donations; foreign-owned companies may need Foreign Investment Act approval
corrections: confirm prior; verified company registration fee WST 250 from MCIL fee schedule (prior WST 100-500 range plausible)

local_bottleneck: Must appoint a Tonga-resident person to accept service and a local registered office; small insular registry.
deduction: deductible for gifts to eligible charitable institutions under Income Tax Act
corrections: confirm prior: resident service agent requirement verified in Companies (Amendment) Regulations 2014
